build_fcn_head: build a Fully Convolutional Network head for semantic segmentation with configurable conv layers
create_fcn_head_instance: create an FCNHead instance with custom num_convs, kernel_size, and dilation parameters
run_forward_fcn_head: run the forward pass of FCNHead on multi-level image feature inputs
review_fcn_head_forward_feature: review the FCNHead _forward_feature method that transforms inputs and optionally concatenates features
test_fcn_head_concat_input: test the FCNHead concat_input feature that merges conv output with input before classification
